evidence.title: Pafolios — The best design portfolio examples and inspiration

name: Pafolios
summary: Curated gallery of 851 design portfolios and case studies from product designers, studios and developers.
description: Browsable collection of portfolio examples and case studies, made so designers can study how others present their work and write better case studies. New portfolios can be submitted, featured owners can opt out, and the project accepts sponsors. The grid itself loads client-side; the catalog indexes 831 gallery examples.
contains: 831 gallery examples indexed by the catalog
browse case studies and a directory; submit your own portfolio
